Production v0.0 Phase 0 report

Phase: Baseline freeze, ADRs, and no-behavior refactor Status: Complete Completed: 2026-07-31 Baseline: 8dd3bc6aab1ab0fe058c5ace8ab1107813cfb441 (production-v0.0-baseline annotated tag)

This report records evidence for Phase 0 only. It does not claim that later production features or the Production v0.0 definition of done are complete.

Checks run

Before Phase 0, the existing Rust formatting, Clippy, workspace tests, Flutter formatting, Flutter analysis, and 58 Flutter tests passed. The first wrapper invocation could not update the Flutter SDK cache under the workspace sandbox; the same Flutter commands were rerun with SDK-cache permission and passed.

After Phase 0, the integrated command below passed with no skipped product step:

./scripts/check.sh

That run included:

  • Rust formatting and workspace Clippy with -D warnings;
  • all Rust workspace unit, integration, and documentation tests;
  • deterministic OpenAPI generation, checked-artifact byte comparison, and four compatibility-checker tests;
  • Flutter dependency resolution, formatting, analysis, and 69 tests;
  • JSON validation and shell syntax checks.

The opt-in migration test that explicitly requires TEST_DATABASE_URL remains ignored by its existing guard during a run without that variable. The other PostgreSQL test binaries completed successfully but returned early through their documented TEST_DATABASE_URL guard, so this local run is not evidence of live database assertions. CI supplies PostgreSQL and exercises them; the local Docker daemon was unavailable for an additional service-backed run.

Migrations added

None. Phase 0 deliberately adds no account, library, comment, moderation, or rate-limit tables. Existing migrations remain unchanged.

API changes

  • Split the former API monolith into application assembly, validated config, stable errors, HTTP DTOs, request-ID/timeout/rate-limit middleware, and health/feed/paper/chat/support route modules.
  • Added typed development, staging, and production environments.
  • Added independent account, library, and comment flags with dependency validation. The flags are retained in AppState, but Phase 0 registers no incomplete feature routes.
  • Added deployed-environment CORS validation. Staging and production require explicit HTTPS origins without wildcards, credentials, paths, queries, or fragments.
  • Production refuses runtime migrations, non-strict full-text policy, and the deterministic model provider.
  • Added code-first utoipa documentation for all ten existing public routes, including success/error bodies and stable wire enums.
  • Added /openapi.json in development/staging only.
  • Added deterministic generation and a checked openapi-v1.json artifact. CI rejects generation drift and removed routes, methods, response codes, properties, component schemas, and narrowed enum values. Schema-enum tests bind the documented values to the actual domain serialization.

Existing paper routes, response serialization, preparation intent, full-text masking, chat ownership, and rate-limit behavior are unchanged. The existing PostgreSQL API integration test changed only to provide the newly required environment/feature configuration fields.

Database changes

  • Replaced the 3,385-line repository module with a stable public facade and focused paper, chat, and private row/codec modules.
  • Preserved every public repository method and SQL string. The split was verified against all 325 original Rust string/raw-string literals and by the DB unit and PostgreSQL behavior suites.
  • Added no speculative account repository or schema.

Mobile changes

  • Added typed build environments and independent account, library, comments, and opening-motion flags. Development defaults preserve the current guest demo with all production flags disabled.
  • Centralized API base URL and full-text policy through validated build config.
  • Production requires HTTPS and strict full-text policy; account-owned flags require accounts; comments require a non-placeholder support URL.
  • Account-enabled builds require issuer, client ID, app-owned callback, and post-logout callback values. Unsafe redirect schemes, loopback production-like universal links, placeholders, and query-bearing callbacks are rejected.
  • Client secrets and provider API keys supplied as mobile build values fail validation instead of being silently bundled.
  • Added eleven focused build-configuration tests while all existing reader, restoration, gesture, resilience, content-policy, and chat tests remain green.

Documentation and operational changes

  • Added the Production v0.0 documentation entrypoint and ADRs 0001–0005.
  • Updated architecture and content policy docs to distinguish the implemented demo from the planned production target.
  • Updated .env.example and README.md with the Phase 0 feature/configuration boundaries and contract commands.
  • Added a dedicated CI contract job with full history for base-artifact compatibility comparison.

Exit-criteria evidence

  • Demo flows unchanged: all pre-existing Rust and Flutter tests pass; no account UI or database table exists; feature defaults are disabled.
  • API fixtures unchanged: existing runtime assertions and wire serializers pass unchanged; the new artifact documents rather than replaces their shapes.
  • Release check: ./scripts/check.sh exits successfully.
  • OpenAPI coverage: the checked document contains exactly the ten existing health/paper routes, and a route-coverage test fails on undocumented drift.
  • No public accounts: no /v1/me, library, comment, or block route is registered, regardless of Phase 0 flag values.

Known risks carried into later phases

  • Phase 1–6 product behavior is intentionally not implemented by this report.
  • The runtime feature manifests must be extended only alongside each complete server safety stack; a flag alone is not authorization.
  • OpenAPI response schemas are compile- and regression-checked, but future account DTOs must continue the same checked-artifact discipline.
  • Device-level navigation and launch-motion acceptance testing belongs to Phase 1 because Phase 0 makes no navigation or visual change.
  • The live PostgreSQL assertions need confirmation in CI or a later local run with TEST_DATABASE_URL; this phase's integrated local check exercised their build and guards, not their database bodies.
  • The local baseline tag must be published with the repository refs when the project is pushed; no remote mutation was performed during this phase.
htmlZh:
生产 v0.0 阶段 0 报告

阶段: 基线冻结、ADR 和无行为重构
状态: 完成
完成日期: 2026-07-31
基线: 8dd3bc6aab1ab0fe058c5ace8ab1107813cfb441
(production-v0.0-baseline 注释标签)

本报告仅记录阶段 0 的证据。它不声称后续生产功能或生产 v0.0 的完成标准是完整的。

运行的检查

在阶段 0, 之前，现有的 Rust 格式化、Clippy、工作区测试、Flutter 格式化、Flutter 分析和 58 个 Flutter 测试通过。第一次包装调用无法在工作区沙箱下更新 Flutter SDK 缓存；相同的 Flutter 命令在 SDK 缓存权限下重新运行并通过。

阶段 0, 之后，以下集成命令通过，没有跳过任何产品步骤：

./scripts/check.sh

该运行包括：

  • Rust 格式化和工作区 Clippy 带有 -D warnings；
  • 所有 Rust 工作区单元测试、集成测试和文档测试；
  • 确定性 OpenAPI 生成、检查的工件字节比较和四个兼容性检查器测试；
  • Flutter 依赖解析、格式化、分析和 69 个测试；
  • JSON 验证和 shell 语法检查。

显式要求 TEST_DATABASE_URL 的 opt-in 迁移测试在没有该变量的运行中仍被其现有 guard 忽略。其他 PostgreSQL 测试二进制文件成功完成，但通过其文档的 TEST_DATABASE_URL guard 提前返回，因此此本地运行不是数据库断言的证据。CI 提供 PostgreSQL 并对其进行测试；本地 Docker 守护进程在额外的服务支持运行中不可用。

添加的迁移

无。阶段 0 故意不添加账户、库、评论、审核或速率限制表。现有迁移保持不变。

API 变化

  • 将原来的 API 单体拆分为应用程序组装、验证配置、稳定错误、HTTP DTO、请求-ID/超时/速率限制中间件，以及健康/文章/论文/聊天/支持路由模块。
  • 添加了类型化的 development、staging 和 production 环境。
  • 添加了独立的账户、库和评论标志，带有依赖验证。这些标志保留在 AppState 中，但阶段 0 不注册任何不完整的功能路由。
  • 添加了部署环境的 CORS 验证。测试和生产环境要求显式的 HTTPS 原点，不带通配符、凭证、路径、查询或片段。
  • 生产环境拒绝运行时迁移、非严格全文策略和确定性模型提供者。
  • 为所有十个现有公开路由添加了代码优先的 utoipa 文档，包括成功/错误正文和稳定的 wire 枚举。
  • 在开发/测试环境中添加了 /openapi.json。
  • 添加了确定性生成和一个检查的 openapi-v1.json 工件。CI 拒绝生成漂移和移除的路由、方法、响应代码、属性、组件模式和缩小的枚举值。模式-枚举测试将文档中的值绑定到实际的领域序列化。

现有的论文路由、响应序列化、准备意图、全文遮蔽、聊天所有权和速率限制行为保持不变。现有的 PostgreSQL API 集成测试仅更改以提供新要求的环境/功能配置字段。

数据库变化

  • 将 3,385- 行的仓库模块替换为稳定的公共外观，并专注于论文、聊天和私有行/编码模块。
  • 保留了所有公共仓库方法和 SQL 字符串。拆分通过所有 325 个原始 Rust 字符串/原始字符串字面量和 DB 单元和 PostgreSQL 行为套件进行验证。
  • 没有添加任何推测的账户仓库或模式。

移动变化

  • 添加了类型化的构建环境和独立的账户、库、评论和打开动作标志。开发默认值保留当前的访客演示，所有生产标志禁用。
  • 通过验证的构建配置集中了 API 基础 URL 和全文策略。
  • 生产环境要求 HTTPS 和严格的全文策略；账户拥有的标志要求账户；评论要求非占位符支持 URL。
  • 账户启用的构建要求签发者、客户端 ID、应用拥有的回调和退出后回调值。不安全的重定向方案、类似生产环境的通用链接、占位符和带有查询的回调被拒绝。
  • 作为移动构建值提供的客户端密钥和提供者 API 密钥在验证失败时不会被静默捆绑。
  • 添加了十一项聚焦的构建配置测试，同时所有现有的读者、恢复、手势、韧性、内容策略和聊天测试保持绿色。

文档和运营变化

  • 添加了生产 v0.0 文档入口点和 ADRs 0001–0005.。
  • 更新了架构和内容策略文档，以区分实现的演示与计划的生产目标。
  • 更新了 .env.example 和 README.md，以包含阶段 0 的功能/配置边界和合同命令。
  • 添加了一个专用的 CI contract 作业，具有完整的历史记录用于基础工件兼容性比较。

退出标准证据

  • 演示流程未变: 所有先前的 Rust 和 Flutter 测试通过；没有账户 UI 或数据库表存在；功能默认值被禁用。
  • API 固定装置未变: 现有的运行时断言和 wire 序列化器保持不变；新的工件文档而非替换其形状。
  • 发布检查: ./scripts/check.sh 退出成功。
  • OpenAPI 覆盖: 检查的文档包含恰好十个现有的健康/论文路由，且路由覆盖测试在未文档化的漂移上失败。
  • 无公开账户: 没有 /v1/me、库、评论或阻止路由被注册，无论阶段 0 标志值如何。

已知的风险带入后续阶段

  • 阶段 1–6 的产品行为在此报告中故意未实现。
  • 运行时功能清单必须在每个完整的服务器安全堆栈旁边扩展；单独的标志不是授权。
  • OpenAPI 响应模式经过编译和回归检查，但未来的账户 DTO 必须继续相同的检查工件纪律。
  • 设备级导航和启动动作接受测试属于阶段 1，因为阶段 0 不进行任何导航或视觉更改。
  • 生产环境的 PostgreSQL 断言需要在 CI 或后续的本地运行中确认，使用 TEST_DATABASE_URL；此阶段的集成本地检查测试了它们的构建和守卫，而不是数据库主体。
  • 本地基线标签必须在项目推送时与仓库引用一起发布；在此阶段没有进行远程更改。
